proposed_fixes.title: Restore trusted Settings-sync communication if signer rejection is confirmed
plan: Check the supplied installation and failure-time diagnostics for SettingsSync untrusted-signature versus another error.
If confirmed, consolidate under issue 50795 rather than starting a competing implementation.
Otherwise trace the actual IPC/transport failure and develop a fix that preserves intended peer identity checks.
verification: Confirm new-key generation and pairing commands reach the engine on a supported test install.
Validate service and non-service modes after any primary-issue correction; do not bypass authentication as a workaround.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The pairing error may be the known Settings/MWB peer-signature rejection, but this report supplies no diagnostic evidence that distinguishes it from transport or other IPC failures.

confidence.rationale: Same release family and message fit 50795, but this issue and its new comment contain only symptoms/screenshots, not the rejection discriminator.

comment.body: Thanks for the report and screenshot. This message can occur when communication between Settings and Mouse Without Borders fails; the message alone does not establish the cause. Please try generating a key or pairing once, then immediately add a comment containing `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP. That distinguishes the signer rejection tracked in #50795 from a transport failure. There is no need to repeat the previous attempts or disable security verification.
